prose:
An FT item carried by Techmeme describes institutional investors selling stakes in older venture funds at discounts to free capital for newer AI funds. It frames a shift in limited-partner allocations rather than a direct sale of all underlying startup assets.

The full FT article could not be read after an alternate fetch timed out. Discount sizes, fund sample, transaction timing and whether sales were proposed or completed remain unresolved here. The feed summary does not establish that every investor is exiting legacy funds, that every AI fund will outperform or that all portfolio companies are distressed.
highlights: Coverage is limited to a feed excerpt
Transactions concern stakes in venture funds
Discounted secondary stakes differ from company valuations
AI allocation is the reported motivation
Sample and deal details remain unread
No investment recommendation or action is made
